evidence_sources.rationale: Defines Plan purpose, inputs, planning concepts, gates, artifact responsibilities, execution-entry policy, handoff obligations, and non-mutation boundary.
Defines Invoke lifecycle authority, independent evidence axes, shared state, global Plan gates, and downstream ownership.
Defines the canonical executable hierarchy, exclusive artifact responsibilities, navigability rules, SWU ownership, and execution-readiness stops.
Retains delivery-slice, dependency, implementation-detail, SWU, validation, blocker, and handoff vocabulary while deferring current authority to WORK-PACK.md and IMPLEMENTATION-LAYERING.md.
Defines the global L0-L3 decision model, promotion evidence, explicit deferral, and non-regression rules.
Defines the canonical planning manifest, internal execution model, execution-entry projection, closeout contract, SWU review, and handoff gates.
Defines medium/high cross-task choreography, baseline-wave requirements, layer-mapped waves, and the prohibition on redefining task or SWU contracts.

The completed prior package confirms domain use of objectives, slices, layers, waves, tasks, SWUs, atomicity, recomposition, validation, gap ownership, one-unit handoff, and lifecycle separation; its receipts, pass claims, selections, and executable state are not current authority.

facets.rationale: The bounded subject is Invoke Plan: non-mutating conversion of admitted design intent into governed, execution-oriented planning artifacts without performing implementation or claiming later lifecycle authority.

The model independently represents the objective, implementation layers, Work Pack, slices, waves, tasks, implementation-detail specs, SWUs, validation, gaps, execution policy, handoff contracts, and readiness boundaries.

Containment, one-parent ownership, layer mapping, dependency order, wave choreography, recomposition, and non-overlapping artifact authority are materialized through definition relations and boundary conditions.

Plan authoring evidence, execution-candidate compatibility proof, exact acceptance, registry release, and mutation runtime readiness remain distinct; historical completion or planned witnesses do not establish current admission.

The model covers input activation, complexity-dependent obligations, SWU atomicity, split analysis, first-unit narrowness, recomposition, navigability, blocker handling, closeout completeness, exact route coverage, and mutation-capable handoff stops.

Plan prepares a finite, route-bound, one-SWU execution contract plus execution-time context inputs and terminal closeout synchronization, while leaving selection, admission, mutation, validation over postimages, and lifecycle closeout to downstream owners.

Invoke owns planning artifacts and handoff context only; admitted design meaning remains upstream-owned, and execution, lifecycle mutation, promotion, publication, deployment, exact acceptance, and runtime admission remain outside Plan authority.
